retrievalProfile.description: A solitary silhouette trapped within a glowing cyan glass pillar amidst a dense, red-tinted industrial fog.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical glass rectangular prism containing a dark silhouette, illuminated by internal cyan lights that contrast against a heavy, red-orange atmospheric haze in a dark industrial setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan internal light vs. red external ambient haze
Sharp vertical glass edges vs. soft volumetric fog
Dark central silhouette vs. bright glowing top lights
Industrial background structure vs. clean geometric enclosure
coreInvariants: Cyan-teal light sources at the top of the glass enclosure
Heavy film grain and volumetric light scattering
A central vertical glass pillar containing a human figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The glass enclosure is centered vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright cyan light sources at the top of the glass pillar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the cyan glow, move down the silhouette, and dissipate into the red fog at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the upper left and right corners provide high contrast for the glowing elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and orange volumetric haze in the lower half.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cyan-teal light within the glass enclosure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Small red industrial signal light in the background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light sources with low value in the surrounding shadows; heavy mid-tone diffusion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark industrial scene with a central vertical glass box. Place cyan lights at the top of the box and fill the lower half of the frame with thick red and orange fog. Include a dark silhouette inside the box.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin sans-serif font with a slight outer glow to match the atmospheric lighting.

verificationChecks: Is the cyan light contained primarily within the glass box?
Is there a distinct red-orange haze in the lower portion?
Is the film grain texture visible and consistent?

mustRedesign: Avoid clean, digital gradients; maintain the gritty analog film look.
Ensure the glass box has visible thickness and refraction.
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of cyan and red color contrast.
Verify the silhouette is obscured by fog and glass.
Ensure the background industrial elements are out of focus.
Confirm the presence of heavy film grain.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central geometric light source with dual-tone complementary atmospheric haze and a low-detail silhouette for a cinematic noir effect.
